title: Bound full serialized task-delta items before delivery
outcome: Bound full serialized task-delta items before delivery
acceptance: Delivery paging accounts for the full serialized delta-item cost and a regression test proves one event cannot permanently wedge cursor advancement.
Task-feed append or validation prevents an object_kind and envelope from making one immutable delta item exceed the delivery capacity.
disposal_reason: Obsolete: production task-delta delivery is gone; task_delta is #[cfg(test)] (src/storage/objects_tasks.rs:42) with test-only callers and grants carry no page; current work-feed delivery is a separate surface. Triage 2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous.
